description: This file contains unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component of the OpenClaw project. It tests various functions such as path display, URL resolution, bootstrap process, and safety checks related to workspace setup.

classes.name: AgentWorkspaceTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of the AgentWorkspace module in OpenClaw.

methods.name: display path uses tilde for home
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath method correctly uses tilde to represent the home directory.

methods.name: resolve workspace URL expands tilde
methods.description: Ensures that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands tilde to an absolute path.

methods.name: agents URL appends filename
methods.description: Checks that agentsURL correctly appends the filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: bootstrap creates agents file when missing
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap creates necessary files in a new workspace.

methods.name: bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents
methods.description: Tests that bootstrapSafety rejects workspaces that are non-empty but lack an agent file.

methods.name: bootstrap safety allows existing agents file
methods.description: Ensures bootstrapSafety accepts workspace with existing agent file.

methods.name: bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap skips creating bootstrap file if workspace already contains other content.

methods.name: needs bootstrap false when identity already set
methods.description: Verifies that needsBootstrap returns false if the identity file already exists with content.
